DOM readiness and script timing

DOMContentLoaded fires after HTML parsing and deferred/module scripts execute; load waits for
dependent resources such as images. Scripts using defer execute after parsing, in document order for
classic deferred scripts.

HTML elements තවම parse කරලා නැත්නම් selector එක null Jවන්න පුළුවන්. DOMContentLoaded එJකන් DOM ready බව දැනගෙන්න. defer script එක parse අවසන් වූ පසු execute Jවනවා. load එක images වැනි resources සඳහාත් බලාJගෙන ඉන්නවා.

Interview question: What is the difference between DOMContentLoaded and load?

Answer: DOMContentLoaded concerns the parsed DOM and relevant scripts; load also waits for
dependent resources.
